verdicts.reason: A is the original strip shrunk and letterboxed: about 60% of the canvas is empty white above and below, and the headline and URL are small. Nothing was rearranged for the new shape. B does rearrange it, with a blue headline panel on top and the photo below, and its type is much larger and easier to read. But it has broken pieces: a white diagonal wedge cuts into the top-right of the blue panel, the stripe lines float loose over the photo's left edge, the photo is shifted right with an uneven gap, and the bottom quarter is dead white. B is the less bad of the two, but neither could ship.
